decision: Three steps: what we build, what we buy, what we give up
why: The same rhythm as Problem A, so the comparison is instant.
value: Founders learn the pattern once and read both problems.

decision: Suggestion ranking is ours, behind one call, starting from a ready tool while there is no data
why: Ranking is why suggestions sell, but it needs history to beat a ready tool.
alternative: Buy a recommendation service for good.
value: No wasted months; ownership arrives when it pays.

decision: The fitting room is bought and opens only after a size is chosen
why: Computer vision at this quality is a company of its own; the gate keeps cost per try in check.
value: The feature ships now with a bounded bill.

decision: Tracking is open source and self-hosted
why: Customer behavior data should stay under our control; the events are standard.
value: Full control of customer data for some upkeep.

decision: Page speed is built, and every release is measured against budgets
why: No tool can make our pages fast for us; it is felt on every visit.
alternative: Rely on a hosting provider's optimizations.
value: Speed is a tested promise, not an accident.
